subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should this docs-first launchd recovery runbook be published before the runtime wrapper and doctor/install hardening from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89791 ships?
rationale: The diff is docs-only and source-backed, but it instructs operators to mutate launchd services and possibly disable a node LaunchAgent, so automation should not decide the availability policy for existing macOS installs.

options.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
options.body: Publish the runbook now with the skip warning and keep the linked runtime hardening issue open for the durable fix.

options.title: Wait For Runtime Hardening
options.body: Hold this PR until wrapper generation and doctor/install repair are ready, avoiding a public manual-service workaround as the primary recovery path.

options.title: Narrow The Runbook
options.body: Merge only detection and wrapper-order diagnostics, and defer node LaunchAgent disable instructions to maintainer-authored docs or doctor repair.

recommendation.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
recommendation.body: Publish the runbook now with the skip warning and keep the linked runtime hardening issue open for the durable fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the strongest recent history across the docs, launchd, service-env, and supervisor-marker surfaces involved in the policy choice.
